assertions.text: Every one of the three helper commands has a literal launcher path and literal argument values, with no shell variable or ${...} expansion anywhere in the command
The plugin root value is obtained from its own echo of "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-.claude}", never from the plugins/ folder of the repository under review
The planner re-run sets GIT_INDEX_FILE to the literal /tmp/tmp.abc/index as a prefix assignment on the same command
A SCOPE value containing a single quote stops the step with a question to the user instead of being typed into a command
A call that is still refused in the literal form is stopped and reported, with no other way of running the step
